8009.title: Selected-model discovery never revisits persisted empty reasoning support
8009.rootCauseOneLine: Same-fingerprint refreshes preserve known-empty reasoning, and selected-model discovery returns early for every known model, even after the persisted store is reloaded.
8009.proposedFix: Choose a discovery-expiry policy; persist per-model discovery age and invalidate both the known result and selected-probe success cache when it expires.
8009.caveats: Shared server-store reproduction using a scripted host-RPC boundary and real migrated SQLite, not a live OpenCode/LM Studio installation. Authoritative known live catalog answers can replace stale data. No simple-fix PR: durable expiry needs stored-data and product-policy changes.
